''See also: [[Architects Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Architects serve as the ruling council of the [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]]. Unlike other orders within the guild that are sent out into the world to gather knowledge, Architects primarily remain on [[Gray Island]]. The group is composed of highly skilled individuals with diverse talents, including strategists, administrators, [[Alchemists|alchemists]], and [[Readers]]. They are characterized by their refined and expensive black clothing, which distinguishes them from the more utilitarian attire of other orders. While they often deliberate in shadowed alcoves to maintain anonymity and allow for honest discussion, the guild is led by three High [[Councilors]]. In terms of their role, the Architects are responsible for designing plans and developing strategies. They focus on finding the most effective tools and methods to achieve specific goals, often prioritizing results over moral considerations. Their [[Authority|authority]] is based on earned respect rather than strictly enforced rank, and they operate under a culture of following orders from clients, the Emperor, or their own council. While they are part of a guild known for its absolute loyalty to [[The Empire|the Empire]], the Architects have shown resistance to changes that might threaten the guild's power, such as the rise of the [[Regents]].}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Architects serve as the ruling council of the [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]] and govern the [[Gray Island]], where they maintain separate quarters for their students. Comprised of individuals who can [[Read]], this group consists of alchemically trained members, including talented healers and [[Alchemists|alchemists]] who breed [[spiders]]. Their operations involve using a combination of alchemy and [[Reading]] to create bait, as well as the construction of specialized boxes. While [[Meia]] often treats their decisions as [[Imperial]] mandates, a cluster of these council members once surrounded [[Shera]] and [[Meia]] at [[Bastion's Shadow]]. Within their domain, the Architects utilize alcoves with [[stone]] benches built directly into the walls.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">14</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Meia]] tends to elevate the will of the [[Architects]] to the level of an [[Imperial]] mandate.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" />}}</li>

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Architects possess the [[Authority|authority]] to command [[Consultants]] to travel to the Capital. Although [[Meia]] lacks any specific information from this group concerning [[Calder]], there is a possibility that the Architects could eventually be brought to his side. [[Meia]] notes that she would be required to report herself to them, even as [[Teach]] plans to force the group into a surrender.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Architects]] can order [[Consultants]] to the Capital.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Meia]] has no information from the [[Architects]] regarding [[Calder]] personally.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Architects]] might be brought to [[Calder]]'s side.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Meia]] mentions that she would have to report herself to the [[Architects]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Architects]] are a group that [[Teach]] intends to force into surrender.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c20">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Architects begin by drafting various design plans. During their preparations, they receive advice to utilize [[alchemical charge|alchemical charges]] against the quarters belonging to the Emperor. The group also holds a meeting to discuss [[Shera]]'s confinement and serves as the body responsible for deciding her ultimate [[Fate|fate]]. Finally, they are observed calculating the approaching trajectory of the [[Navigator ships]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Architects]] are advised to use [[alchemical charge|alchemical charges]] against the [[Emperor's quarters]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c15">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Architects]] are the group responsible for determining [[Shera]]'s [[Fate|fate]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c17">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Architects]] are responsible for meeting regarding [[Shera]]'s confinement.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Architects]] were calculating the approach of the [[Navigator ships]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Architects are an influential organization whose actions [[Lucan]] is currently investigating. This group possesses the [[Authority|authority]] to grant or deny permission for specific actions and maintains a hierarchy where [[Readers]] report directly to them. While the High [[Council]] consults with various members, particularly those trained in history and [[Readers]], the Architects focus on planning strategies and seeking out necessary tools. They believe that specific alchemy is designed to immobilize or restrain powerful enemies, an ability demonstrated when they locate a restrained [[Zhen of the Masons|Zhen]]. Ultimately, the organization grows increasingly excited as more individuals successfully become [[Soulbound]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Architects]] believed the chosen alchemy was intended to restrain or immobilize powerful opponents.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Architects]] are a group whose actions [[Lucan]] is investigating.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Architects]] have the power to grant or deny permission for certain actions.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Zhen of the Masons|Zhen]] threatened to have the [[Architects]] knock [[Lucan]] back down to a recruit.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Architects]] have discussed options with [[Kerian]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Architects]] plan and look for strategies and tools.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] consulted with other [[Architects]], primarily [[Readers]] and those trained in history.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Architects]] are an organization that can find [[Zhen of the Masons|Zhen]] immobilized.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Readers]] are found among the [[Architects]] at [[Shera]]'s meeting.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Architects]] are a group that [[Readers]] report to.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Architects]] grow more excited with every new person that comes out successfully [[Soulbound]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
